units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:3:3">Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דשַׁכְחוּן כולן</he>, v. <cite ref="O00322"><he>סוּלָּמָא</he></cite>

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U01137">same</cite>. Y. Erub. I, 18ᵈ top [read:] <he>דאין … ולא מְשַכַּח יתיה</he> that he may not have forgotten it, if Rab should ask him; a. e.

units: <cite ref="Temurah 15b">Tem. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>דאי׳ להו א׳ וכ׳</he> that which they forgot remained forgotten &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:10-21">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>יתיב … דלִשְׁתַּכַּח גמרא וכ׳</he> he fasted … praying that he may forget the Babylonian teaching.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:5">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מִשְׁתַּכְּחַת תורה וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Ketubot 103b">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>אם נשתכחה וכ׳</he>), v. <cite ref="Q01112"><he>פִּלְפּוּלָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b">Ib.</cite> <he>עבדי … דלא תִשְׁתַּכַּח וכ׳</he> I brought it about that the Law be not forgotten &c.; a. e.
